description: This file defines the ForLoopNode class, an internal node used within the Twig templating engine to represent and compile 'for' loop constructs. It primarily manages loop-related attributes and generates the corresponding PHP code during compilation.

classes.name: Twig\Node\ForLoopNode
classes.description: Represents a 'for' loop node within the Twig abstract syntax tree, managing loop attributes and code compilation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ForLoopNode with line number and default attributes.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code for the 'for' loop, handling loop counters, first/last flags, and else condition.
